groups.finding: A5 is IF(MOD(A4,2)=1,"Odd","Even"), a formula that returns text. Its stored bits are 7ff0ffffffffffff (sign 0, exponent 7FF, fraction non-zero), the WSFF2 STRING pattern (S27), so the file keeps the text in a following record the parser skips (open question 4). The engine computes a string and cannot compare it with a stored number, so the cell is unverifiable, not wrong. Its two inputs are plain numbers (A4 = number, docs/verify-evidence.md).
